title: vectra Engine Reference
text: vectra R-native columnar query engine datasets don’t fit memory. provides dplyr-style verbs backed pure C11 pull-based execution engine custom -disk format (.vtr). operations lazy collect() materializes results R data.frame. vectra dplyr backend plugin. defines S3 generics. verbs share names semantics dplyr, depend .

title: vectra Engine Reference
text: Every verb (filter, select, mutate, …) builds plan node. Nodes form tree. data moves collect() calls root node’s next_batch() function, pulls data tree one row group time. row group (internally: VecBatch) set columnar arrays, typically thousands millions rows. column typed array validity bitmap NA support.
code: # Nothing executes here --- just builds a plan tree plan <- tbl("data.vtr") |>   filter(x > 0) |>   select(id, x, y) |>   mutate(z = x + y)  # Data flows when you call collect() result <- collect(plan)  # Or inspect the plan without executing it explain(plan)

title: vectra Engine Reference
text: arrange() uses external merge sort accumulated data exceeds 1 GB. Sorted runs spilled temporary .vtr files, merged via k-way min-heap. keeps peak memory bounded regardless input size. sort-based group_by() |> summarise() path (used internally engine detects advantageous) also benefits spill mechanism.

title: vectra Engine Reference
text: Joins use build-right, probe-left hash join: Build phase: entire right-side table materialized hash table memory. Probe phase: Left-side batches stream one time, probing hash table. Finalize phase (full_join ): Unmatched right-side rows emitted chunks 65,536 rows. memory cost join proportional right-side table size. left side streams accumulate.

text: user-facing verbs (filter, select, mutate, etc.) build tree vectra_node objects R. node wraps C-level VecNode external pointer. data moves collect() calls C_collect, pulls VecBatch structs node tree one row group time.

title: CLAUDE.md
text: Custom binary columnar format defined src/vtr1.h. file contains: header (version + schema + row group count), row group index, column data per row group. Columns stored typed arrays validity bitmaps NA support. write_vtr() writes R data.frames; tbl() opens lazy reading.

title: CLAUDE.md
text: Pure C11, external dependencies. Key types src/types.h: - VecType: int64, double, bool, string - VecArray: single column validity bitmap type-punned data union - VecBatch: row group (n columns + optional selection vector zero-copy filtering) - VecNode: pull-based plan node next_batch() free_node() vtable Plan nodes (.h/.c pair): - scan (vtr file reader) -> filter -> project (select/mutate/rename) -> sort -> limit - topn (combined sort+limit optimization) - group_agg (hash-based grouping + aggregation: n, sum, mean, min, max) - join (hash join: left, inner, right, full, semi, anti) - window (row_number, rank, dense_rank, lag, lead, cumsum, cummean, cummin, cummax) - concat (union / bind_rows) Format backends (scan + write, .h/.c pair): - csv_scan / csv_write: streaming CSV type inference first 1000 rows - sql_scan / sql_write: SQLite read/write via embedded sqlite3 (sqlite_format.c) - tiff_scan / tiff_write: GeoTIFF raster read/write (pixels → rows x, y, band columns) R--C bridge: src/r_bridge.c implements C_* entry points registered src/init.c.

title: CLAUDE.md
text: tbl.R: Entry points format backends: tbl() (vtr), tbl_csv(), tbl_sqlite(), tbl_tiff(). write.R: Writers formats: write_vtr(), write_csv(), write_sqlite(), write_tiff(). Writers S3 generics dispatching vectra_node (streaming) data.frame. expr.R: NSE expression serializer. Captures R expressions (arithmetic, comparison, boolean, .na) nested lists C bridge interprets. translation layer dplyr-style expressions C engine. verbs.R: dplyr verb implementations S3 methods vectra_node. Verbs build new nodes via .Call() C entry points. joins.R: Join verbs + parse_join_keys() argument handling. across.R: across() expansion mutate/summarise. windows.R: Window function detection node creation. bind.R: bind_rows() (streaming ConcatNode schemas match, R fallback otherwise) bind_cols(). reframe.R: Variable-length summarise via collect() fallback. explain.R: Prints query plan tree debugging.

title: CLAUDE.md
text: R integers stored VEC_INT64 internally returned double default (native int64 base R). bit64::integer64 support optional via Suggests.

title: CLAUDE.md
text: Rcpp: Direct .Call() interface C via registered routines. C++ anywhere. Selection vectors: VecBatch.sel enables zero-copy filtering (filter node sets selection vector rather copying rows). String ownership: VecArray.owns_data flag distinguishes owned vs borrowed string buffers avoid double-free hash join arenas. Grouping metadata-: group_by() just attaches .groups R list; C-level group_agg node receives key names summarise() called.

code: library(vectra)  # CSV — lazy scan with type inference tbl_csv("measurements.csv") |>   filter(temperature > 30, year >= 2020) |>   group_by(station) |>   summarise(avg_temp = mean(temperature), n = n()) |>   collect()  # GeoTIFF — climate rasters as tidy data tbl_tiff("worldclim_bio1.tif") |>   filter(band1 > 0) |>   mutate(temp_c = band1 / 10) |>   collect()  # SQLite — zero-dependency, no DBI required tbl_sqlite("survey.db", "responses") |>   filter(year == 2025) |>   left_join(tbl_sqlite("survey.db", "sites"), by = "site_id") |>   collect() write_vtr(big_df, "data.vtr", batch_size = 100000)  tbl("data.vtr") |>   filter(x > 0, region == "EU") |>   group_by(region) |>   summarise(total = sum(value), n = n()) |>   collect() tbl("data.vtr") |>   filter(x > 0) |>   select(id, x) |>   explain() #> vectra execution plan #> #> ProjectNode [streaming] #>   FilterNode [streaming] #>     ScanNode [streaming, 2/5 cols (pruned), predicate pushdown, v3 stats] #> #> Output columns (2): #>   id <int64> #>   x <double>

title: Columnar Query Engine for Larger-Than-RAM Data
text: Querying large datasets R usually means Arrow, DuckDB, Spark. work, dependency chains heavy installation fragile. vectra self-contained C11 engine compiled standard R extension. external libraries, JVM, runtime configuration. provides: Streaming execution: data flows one row group time, never fully memory Zero-copy filtering: selection vectors avoid row duplication Query optimizer: column pruning skips unneeded columns scan; predicate pushdown uses per-rowgroup min/max statistics skip entire row groups Hash joins: build right, stream left — join 50 GB fact table lookup without materializing External sort: 1 GB memory budget automatic spill--disk Window functions: row_number(), rank(), dense_rank(), lag(), lead(), cumsum(), cummean(), cummin(), cummax() String expressions: nchar(), substr(), grepl() evaluated engine without round-tripping R Multiple data sources: .vtr, CSV, SQLite, GeoTIFF — produce lazy query nodes

title: vectra 0.1.0
text: Initial release. Custom columnar -disk format (.vtr) multi-row-group support. dplyr-compatible verbs: filter(), select(), mutate(), transmute(), rename(), relocate(), group_by(), summarise(), count(), tally(), distinct(), reframe(), arrange(), slice_head(), slice_tail(), slice_min(), slice_max(), pull(). Hash joins: left_join(), inner_join(), right_join(), full_join(), semi_join(), anti_join(). bind_rows() bind_cols() combining queries. Window functions: row_number(), lag(), lead(), cumsum(), cummean(), cummin(), cummax(). across() support mutate() summarise(). explain() inspecting execution plan. tidyselect integration column selection helpers. Data sources: .vtr, CSV, SQLite, GeoTIFF. Data sinks: write_csv(), write_sqlite(), write_tiff().
